text: Ireland has long, **white** licence plates with the standard European **blue strip** on the left.
The white backplate is especially useful to distinguish it from the UK, which uses yellow backplates (but white fronts). In addition, most UK vehicles lack the blue strip on the left.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭擁有長型的**白色**車牌，左側有標準的歐洲**藍色條紋**。
白色的後車牌特別有助於將其與英國區分開來，英國使用的是黃色後車牌（但前車牌是白色）。此外，大多數英國車輛左側沒有藍色條紋。

text: It is very common to see **yellow outside dashes** on Irish roads.
NOTE: This is essentially never found in the UK. These dashes can also be seen in New Zealand.
text_zh: 在愛爾蘭道路上非常常見到**黃色外側虛線**。
注意：這在英國基本上找不到。這些虛線也可以在紐西蘭看到。

text: You will usually find cream white buildings with black roofs in Ireland. Sometimes, the buildings feature grey corner stones. In cities, you will typically find row buildings.
NOTE: British style brick buildings can still be found in Ireland.
text_zh: 在愛爾蘭，通常會看到奶油白色建築搭配黑色屋頂。有時，建築物會有灰色轉角石。在城市中，通常會看到連棟房屋。
注意：在愛爾蘭仍然可以找到英式風格的磚造建築。

text: Ireland is the only European country that uses yellow **diamond-shaped** warning signs.
Note that this only applies to warning signs. Regulatory signs (circles and upside down triangles) have the normal red border and white background, like most other European countries.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭是唯一使用黃色**菱形**警告標誌的歐洲國家。
請注意，這僅適用於警告標誌。管制標誌（圓形和倒三角形）具有正常的紅邊和白底，就像大多數其他歐洲國家一樣。

text: Irish signage is often bilingual, with English in a regular font, and **Irish in italics**. Place names, regular words and phrases are all translated.
Irish language is somewhat less common on non-official signage.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的標誌通常是雙語的，英文使用一般字體，**愛爾蘭語使用斜體**。地名、一般單字和片語都會被翻譯。
愛爾蘭語在非官方標誌上比較少見。

text: Irish chevrons are **yellow on black**. Both single and multiple arrows are common.
NOTE: UK chevrons are white on black.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的轉彎標誌是**黑底黃字**。單一箭頭和多重箭頭都很常見。
注意：英國的轉彎標誌是黑底白字。

text: The yellow warning stickers on utility poles can be a good way to distinguish between Ireland and the UK.
The most important difference is that UK stickers feature a [guy getting zapped](https://goo.gl/maps/WiwaLDcn6Amn4Mw59) by a lightning bolt.
The Irish stickers usually have a lightning bolt, but **lack the guy getting zapped**. They also often have an extra second rectangular sticker with a black outline, below the lightning bolt.
text_zh: 電線桿上的黃色警告貼紙是區分愛爾蘭和英國的好方法。
最重要的區別在於英國的貼紙上有一個[被閃電電擊的人](https://goo.gl/maps/WiwaLDcn6Amn4Mw59)。
愛爾蘭的貼紙通常也有閃電標誌，但**沒有被電擊的人**。它們通常還會在閃電標誌下方多出一張帶有黑色外框的長方形貼紙。

text: Irish yield signs feature the word “**YIELD**”.
NOTE: UK yield signs have the phrase “GIVE WAY”.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的讓路標誌上有「**YIELD**」這個字。
注意：英國的讓路標誌上有「GIVE WAY」字樣。

text: These **green and white bollards** can be a good clue for Ireland. They are not entirely unique to the country, but they are especially helpful in 50-50s with the UK.
text_zh: 這些**綠白相間的路樁**是愛爾蘭的好線索。它們雖然不是該國獨有，但在與英國進行 50-50 二選一時特別有用。

text: Rural metal gates with **rounded corners** are very common in Ireland.

NOTE: This is mainly useful to distinguish it from [the UK](https://goo.gl/maps/2ZVv7S5ptae1sxbU9), where similar gates typically have square corners. However, gates in [Northern Ireland](https://goo.gl/maps/y1AK7sL8MgoDdmVm9) also typically have rounded corners.
text_zh: 帶有**圓角**的鄉村金屬大門在愛爾蘭非常常見。
注意：這主要用於與[英國](https://goo.gl/maps/2ZVv7S5ptae1sxbU9)區分，英國的類似大門通常是方角。不過，[北愛爾蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/y1AK7sL8MgoDdmVm9)的大門通常也是圓角。

text: You will often see a **strip of grass** in the middle of tiny rural roads. Such roads are called “[boreens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boreen)”. While not unique, these boreens can often be a strong clue in a tough 50-50 between Ireland and the UK.
text_zh: 你經常會在狹窄的鄉間小路中間看到**一條草帶**。這樣的道路被稱為「[愛爾蘭鄉間小路](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boreen)」。雖然並非獨有，但在愛爾蘭與英國之間難分難解的 50 對 50 情況中，這些鄉間小路通常能成為強力的線索。

text: Ireland and the UK **drive on the left side** of the road.
NOTE: The only other European countries to drive on the left are Malta and Cyprus, but landscape should be sufficient to tell them apart.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國都是**靠左側駕駛**。
注意：歐洲其他靠左側駕駛的國家只有馬爾他和賽普勒斯，但景觀應該足以將它們區分開來。

text: Most of Ireland is dominated by a very green, agricultural landscape, with lots of **hedgerows** next to the roads and dividing the fields.
This type of landscape is also common in many parts of the UK, and can be virtually indistinguishable from Ireland.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭大部分地區都是翠綠的農業景觀，道路旁和農田之間有許多**樹籬**。
這種景觀在英國許多地區也很常見，幾乎無法與愛爾蘭區分。

text: Both Ireland and the UK use **wooden** utility poles. Pole steps bolted on the side of the pole are very common. These pole steps are shaped like a series of thin horizontal metal rods.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國都使用**木製**電線桿。桿側用螺栓固定的爬桿釘非常常見。這些爬桿釘的形狀就像一排細長的水平金屬桿。

text: Both Ireland and the UK occasionally have **metal crossbars** on their wooden poles.
NOTE: These types of crossbars are also common in Sweden and Finland.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國的木製電線桿上偶爾也會有**金屬橫樑**。
注意：這種型式的橫樑在瑞典和芬蘭也很常見。

text: In and around urban areas, you will sometimes encounter **double yellow road lines** on the sides of marked roads. These indicate a no parking zone, and are also very common in the UK. They are not really found anywhere else in Europe apart from Malta, but landscape should be sufficient to tell it apart.
text_zh: 在市區及周邊地區，你有時會在標線道路的側邊遇到**雙黃道路標線**。這些標線代表禁止停車區，在英國也非常常見。除了馬爾他之外，它們在歐洲其他地方幾乎找不到，但景觀應該足以將其區分開來。

text: Pedestrian crossing signs are somewhat rare in Ireland. They are yellow and diamond-shaped, like other road signs.
Instead of pedestrian signs, you will often see these **black and white signposts** with a yellow bulb on top.
Note that the UK uses exactly the same signposts.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的行人穿越道標誌相對罕見。它們是黃色且呈菱形，與其他道路標誌類似。
你會經常看到這些**黑白標誌柱**上方帶有黃色燈泡，而不是行人穿越道標誌。
請注意，英國使用的標誌柱完全相同。

text: Ireland has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭擁有第 4 代「小型相機 (smallcam)」街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般的第 4 代相機低，且具有相對大的圓形模糊區域，前方帶有一個小突起。模糊區域也可能是完全透明的，這使得它更難被發現。

text: Irish **regional roads** have 3-digit road numbers. The first digit of these road numbers gives you a general region within the country (see the infographic).
A good mnemonic to remember the rough location of each region: the numbers go in an anti-clockwise direction around the island, starting in Dublin.
Two important notes:
- There is some overlap between numbers at the borders of each region, as well as some rare exceptions
- Roads starting with 8 or 9 are newer roads that are mostly not limited to a certain region (though about half of the 8s are in the Dublin metro area).
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的**區域道路**有 3 位數的道路編號。這些道路編號的第一位數代表了該國的大致區域（請參閱資訊圖表）。
記住各個區域大約位置的好口訣：這些數字以逆時針方向繞著愛爾蘭島排列，從都柏林開始。
兩個重要注意事項：
- 各區域邊界的編號會有些許重疊，也有一些罕見的例外情況
- 以 8 或 9 開頭的道路是較新的道路，通常不受特定區域限制（不過其中大約有一半位於都柏林都會區）。

text: Irish phone numbers start with a two digit **area code**. The area codes are grouped geographically by first digit, and are therefore very learnable.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的電話號碼開頭是兩位數的**區域碼**。區域碼依第一位數字按地理位置分組，因此非常容易學習。

text: Ireland’s west coast is defined by a **rugged, hilly landscape**. Steep hills and low mountains dominate. The neat fields of the east make way for wild grass- and moorlands. The grass often has more brownish and yellow tones to it. Sometimes you will be able to see exposed rocks.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的西海岸有著**崎嶇且多山的地景**。陡峭的山丘與低矮的山脈佔據了大片地區。東部的平坦農田在這裡轉變為野草叢生的大片草地與荒原。草地通常帶有更多褐色與黃色的色調。有時你能看見裸露的岩石。

text: If a very small rural road has **Generation 4** coverage and is located in an unusually **hilly** landscape, you are likely to be in Donegal.

Note that this meta only applies to the smallest roads: thin, without road lines, and sometimes with grass in the middle. This type of coverage is also not exclusive to Donegal, it is just likely to be there.
text_zh: 如果一條非常小的鄉間小路有**第四代**相機的街景覆蓋，且位於異常**多山**的地景中，你很可能就在多尼戈爾（Donegal）。
請注意，這個特徵線索僅適用於最小的道路：狹窄、沒有道路標線，有時中間還長著草。這種拍攝畫質也不是多尼戈爾所獨有的，只是很有可能會在那裡遇到。

text: One noteworthy area in the east is the **Wicklow Mountains**, just south of Dublin. They can look deceptively similar to the western coastal mountains. It can be very hard, if not downright impossible to distinguish these two areas.
Two things to look out for:
- You will never see the coast from the Wicklow mountains.
- Like Donegal, its small roads are mostly covered with Generation 4 instead of the Generation 2 that is more typically associated with small roads in the west.
text_zh: 東部一個值得注意的區域是位於都柏林正南方的**威克洛山脈**（Wicklow Mountains）。它們看起來可能跟西海岸的山脈極為相似。要區分這兩個地區非常困難，甚至可以說是不可能的任務。
有兩件事需要注意：
- 你絕不可能從威克洛山脈（Wicklow mountains）看到海岸線。
- 就像多尼戈爾一樣，其小路大多採用 Generation 4 拍攝畫質，而不是西部小路通常搭配的 Generation 2。

text: An electrical vehicle (EV) with a Generation 4 camera was used to cover most of Eastern Ireland and parts of the Northwest. The **back of the EV is visible** in all this coverage: it is grey with a black semicircle.
Note that not all Generation 4 coverage in and around Dublin is made with this car. A considerable amount still has the regular blue Generation 4 car.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭東部大部分地區以及西北部部分地區的街景覆蓋是由一台配備第四代相機的電動車（EV）所拍攝。在所有這些街景中**都可以看到電動車的車尾**：它是灰色的，帶有一個黑色的半圓形。
請注意，都柏林內及其周邊並非所有 Generation 4 拍攝畫質都是由這輛車拍攝的。相當大一部分仍然使用的是一般藍色的 Generation 4 車輛。

text: In the north of counties Sligo and Leitrim you can find distinctive **tabletop mountains**.
Note that the mountains in the image are just an example, many of the mountains in this area have the same sort of shape.
text_zh: 在斯利、戈縣（Sligo）與利特里姆郡（Leitrim）的北部，你可以找到外形獨特的**桌山**。
請注意，圖片中的山脈只是一個例子，該地區的許多山脈都有著類似的形狀。

text: The area in and around Burren National Park is characterised by a unique [karst landscape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karst) consisting of **exposed grey limestone rocks**.
text_zh: 巴倫國家公園（Burren National Park）內部及周邊地區的特徵是獨特的[喀斯特地形](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karst)，由**裸露的灰色石灰岩**組成。

text: Cork is relatively unique in that it is significantly more **hilly** than the other big Irish cities.
text_zh: 科克（Cork）相對獨特，因為它比其他愛爾蘭的大城市要**多山**得多。
